title: Bargaining at the market
goal: Haggle for a vintage leather bag at a market stall.

steps.partner_zh: 随便看看，这些都是老货。
steps.partner_en: Have a look, these are all old pieces.
steps.prompt_en: Ask how much the brown leather bag is.
answers_zh: 那个棕色的皮包多少钱？
请问这个皮包怎么卖？
answers_en: How much is that brown leather bag?
How much is this leather bag?

steps.partner_zh: 这个是八十年代的，八百块。
steps.partner_en: This one's from the eighties. Eight hundred.
steps.prompt_en: Point out it's a bit worn and offer four hundred.
answers_zh: 有点儿旧了，四百怎么样？
这里都磨坏了，四百块吧。
answers_en: It's a bit worn, how about four hundred?
It's worn here; four hundred.

steps.partner_zh: 四百太少了，我进货都不止这个价。
steps.partner_en: Four hundred's too little; I paid more than that for it.
steps.prompt_en: Say you're a student and offer five hundred as your final price.
answers_zh: 我是学生，五百，不能再多了。
五百吧，这是我最后的价格。
answers_en: I'm a student; five hundred, I can't go higher.
Five hundred, that's my final price.

steps.partner_zh: 唉，六百，你拿走。
steps.partner_en: Sigh, six hundred and it's yours.
steps.prompt_en: Pretend to walk away politely.
answers_zh: 那算了，我再看看别的。
太贵了，我去别家看看。
answers_en: Never mind, I'll look at other things.
Too expensive, I'll try elsewhere.

steps.partner_zh: 好好好，五百五，真的不能再少了！
steps.partner_en: Fine, fine, five-fifty, I really can't go lower!
steps.prompt_en: Accept the deal.
answers_zh: 成交！
好吧，五百五就五百五。
answers_en: Deal!
Alright, five-fifty it is.

closing_zh: 你真会讲价！下次再来啊。
closing_en: You really know how to haggle! Come again.

title: Seeing a doctor
goal: Describe your symptoms and understand the advice.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，哪里不舒服？
steps.partner_en: Hello, what seems to be the problem?
steps.prompt_en: Say your stomach has hurt since last night.
answers_zh: 我从昨天晚上开始肚子疼。
昨天晚上起肚子一直疼。
answers_en: My stomach has hurt since last night.
My stomach has been hurting since last night.

steps.partner_zh: 昨天吃了什么？
steps.partner_en: What did you eat yesterday?
steps.prompt_en: Say you had spicy hotpot and a cold drink.
answers_zh: 吃了很辣的火锅，还喝了冰饮料。
我吃了火锅，喝了冰的。
answers_en: Very spicy hotpot, and a cold drink.
I had hotpot and something iced.

steps.partner_zh: 有没有拉肚子？
steps.partner_en: Any diarrhoea?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, three times this morning.
answers_zh: 有，今天早上拉了三次。
拉了，早上三次。
answers_en: Yes, three times this morning.
Yes, three times in the morning.

steps.partner_zh: 应该是肠胃炎。这几天吃清淡一点儿。
steps.partner_en: It's probably gastroenteritis. Eat plain food for a few days.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether you need to take medicine.
answers_zh: 需要吃药吗？
要不要吃什么药？
answers_en: Do I need medicine?
Should I take any medicine?

steps.partner_zh: 我给你开一点儿药，一天三次。
steps.partner_en: I'll prescribe something; three times a day.
steps.prompt_en: Ask when you can eat spicy food again.
answers_zh: 什么时候可以吃辣的？
我多久以后能吃辣？
answers_en: When can I eat spicy food?
How long until I can have spicy food?

closing_zh: 至少一个星期以后。好好休息！
closing_en: At least a week. Get some rest!

title: Calling the landlord
goal: Report a broken water heater and arrange a repair.

steps.partner_zh: 喂，你好，有什么事吗？
steps.partner_en: Hello, what's up?
steps.prompt_en: Say the water heater is broken and there's no hot water.
answers_zh: 热水器坏了，没有热水。
家里的热水器坏了，不能洗澡。
answers_en: The water heater's broken, no hot water.
The water heater's broken; I can't shower.

steps.partner_zh: 什么时候坏的？
steps.partner_en: When did it break?
steps.prompt_en: Say it stopped working the day before yesterday.
answers_zh: 前天就不能用了。
从前天开始就坏了。
answers_en: It stopped working the day before yesterday.
It's been broken since the day before yesterday.

steps.partner_zh: 我找师傅明天下午去看看，你在家吗？
steps.partner_en: I'll get a repairman to come tomorrow afternoon. Will you be in?
steps.prompt_en: Say you have class in the afternoon; ask if the morning works.
answers_zh: 我下午有课，上午可以吗？
下午不在，上午行不行？
answers_en: I have class in the afternoon; is the morning OK?
I'm out in the afternoon; does the morning work?

steps.partner_zh: 行，那就明天上午十点。
steps.partner_en: Fine, ten tomorrow morning then.
steps.prompt_en: Ask who pays for the repair.
answers_zh: 修理费谁付？
请问修的钱是您付吗？
answers_en: Who pays for the repair?
Will you be paying for the repair?

closing_en: Don't worry, I'll pay for that.

title: Dinner with friends
goal: Order several dishes for a group, then ask for a doggy bag.

steps.partner_zh: 几位要点什么？
steps.partner_en: What would you all like?
steps.prompt_en: Ask what the restaurant's speciality is.
answers_zh: 你们这儿的招牌菜是什么？
有什么推荐的吗？
answers_en: What's your signature dish?
Anything you'd recommend?

steps.partner_zh: 我们的红烧肉和酸菜鱼都很有名。
steps.partner_en: Our braised pork and pickled-cabbage fish are both famous.
steps.prompt_en: Order both, plus a vegetable dish.
answers_zh: 那两个都要，再来一个青菜。
红烧肉、酸菜鱼，再加一个炒青菜。
answers_en: We'll have both, plus a greens dish.
Braised pork, pickled fish, and stir-fried greens.

steps.partner_zh: 酸菜鱼要辣的吗？
steps.partner_en: Would you like the fish spicy?
steps.prompt_en: Say medium spicy, because one friend can't eat very spicy food.
answers_zh: 中辣吧，我朋友不太能吃辣。
微辣就行，有人怕辣。
answers_en: Medium, my friend can't handle much spice.
Mild is fine, someone's scared of spice.

steps.partner_zh: 吃得怎么样？还需要什么吗？
steps.partner_en: How was everything? Need anything else?
steps.prompt_en: Say it was great; ask for the bill and a box for leftovers.
answers_zh: 很好吃！买单，再帮我们打包。
太好吃了。麻烦打包，然后买单。
answers_en: Delicious! The bill, and could you box this up?
So good. Please box this up, then the bill.

title: Joining a gym
goal: Ask about membership and avoid being upsold.

steps.partner_zh: 你好！想了解一下我们的会员卡吗？
steps.partner_en: Hi! Want to hear about our memberships?
steps.prompt_en: Ask how much a monthly card costs.
answers_zh: 月卡多少钱？
一个月的卡怎么收费？
answers_en: How much is a monthly card?
What's the charge for a month?

steps.partner_zh: 月卡三百，但是年卡更划算，只要两千。
steps.partner_en: Monthly is 300, but the annual card is better value, just 2,000.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'd like to try one month first.
answers_zh: 我想先试一个月。
先办月卡吧，看看习惯不习惯。
answers_en: I'd like to try one month first.
Monthly first; let's see if I get used to it.

steps.partner_zh: 我们还有私教课，第一节免费。
steps.partner_en: We also have personal training; the first session is free.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if you have to buy more sessions after the free one.
answers_zh: 免费课以后一定要买吗？
上完免费的，必须继续买吗？
answers_en: Do I have to buy more after the free one?
After the free session, must I keep buying?

steps.partner_zh: 不一定，你自己决定。
steps.partner_en: Not necessarily, it's up to you.
steps.prompt_en: Say fine, you'll sign up for the monthly card today.
answers_zh: 好，那我今天办月卡。
行，今天先办一张月卡。
answers_en: OK, I'll get the monthly card today.
Fine, a monthly card for today.

closing_en: Great, please fill in this form.

title: Lost property
goal: Report a bag you left on the metro.

steps.partner_zh: 您好，需要帮忙吗？
steps.partner_en: Hello, do you need help?
steps.prompt_en: Say you left your bag on the train.
answers_zh: 我把包忘在地铁上了。
我的包落在车上了。
answers_en: I left my bag on the metro.
I left my bag on the train.

steps.partner_zh: 是几号线？大概几点？
steps.partner_en: Which line? Roughly what time?
steps.prompt_en: Say line 2, about twenty minutes ago.
answers_zh: 二号线，大概二十分钟以前。
二号线，二十分钟前下的车。
answers_en: Line 2, about twenty minutes ago.
Line 2, I got off twenty minutes ago.

steps.partner_zh: 包是什么样子的？
steps.partner_en: What does the bag look like?
steps.prompt_en: Say it's a black backpack with a laptop in it.
answers_zh: 是一个黑色的双肩包，里面有电脑。
黑色的背包，里面有一台笔记本电脑。
answers_en: A black backpack with a computer inside.
A black rucksack with a laptop in it.

steps.partner_zh: 请留一下您的电话，找到了马上通知您。
steps.partner_en: Please leave your number; we'll tell you as soon as it's found.
steps.prompt_en: Give your number and ask how long it usually takes.
answers_zh: 好的。一般要多长时间？
我的电话在这儿。大概要多久？
answers_en: OK. How long does it usually take?
Here's my number. About how long?

closing_zh: 一般一两个小时就有消息。
closing_en: Usually there's news within an hour or two.

title: Debating a match
goal: Argue about a penalty decision with another fan.

steps.partner_zh: 刚才那个点球绝对不应该给！
steps.partner_en: That penalty just now should never have been given!
steps.prompt_en: Disagree: say you think it was a foul.
answers_zh: 我觉得是犯规啊。
我不同意，那明明是犯规。
answers_en: I think it was a foul.
I disagree, it was clearly a foul.

steps.partner_zh: 他自己摔倒的，根本没碰到！
steps.partner_en: He fell over on his own, there was no contact!
steps.prompt_en: Say the replay shows he touched his leg.
answers_zh: 你看回放，他碰到腿了。
回放里很清楚，他踢到了对方的腿。
answers_en: Watch the replay, he touched the leg.
The replay's clear: he kicked the other player's leg.

steps.partner_zh: 好吧……可是裁判今天真的很偏心。
steps.partner_en: Fine... but the ref's been really biased today.
steps.prompt_en: Half-agree, and say the first half was worse.
answers_zh: 这个我同意，上半场更差。
有一点儿，上半场判得更不公平。
answers_en: That I agree with; the first half was worse.
A bit; the first half was even less fair.

steps.partner_zh: 你觉得最后谁会赢？
steps.partner_en: Who do you think will win in the end?
steps.prompt_en: Predict a two-one win for your team.
answers_zh: 我觉得我们二比一赢。
我们会赢，二比一。
answers_en: I think we'll win two-one.
We'll win, two-one.

closing_zh: 那我们打个赌，输了请喝啤酒！
closing_en: Let's bet on it then: loser buys the beer!

title: Asking a colleague for help
goal: Politely ask a colleague to explain a spreadsheet.

steps.partner_zh: 怎么了？看你好像很着急。
steps.partner_en: What's up? You look stressed.
steps.prompt_en: Say you don't understand this spreadsheet and ask if they have time.
answers_zh: 这个表格我看不懂，你现在有空吗？
不好意思，这个表我不太明白，能帮我看看吗？
answers_en: I can't make sense of this spreadsheet; are you free now?
Sorry, I don't really get this sheet; could you take a look?

steps.partner_zh: 可以，哪里不明白？
steps.partner_en: Sure, which part?
steps.prompt_en: Ask why the total in this column is different from last month.
answers_zh: 这一列的总数为什么和上个月不一样？
为什么这里的合计跟上个月不同？
answers_en: Why is this column's total different from last month?
Why doesn't this total match last month?

steps.partner_zh: 因为这个月多了两笔退款。
steps.partner_en: Because there were two extra refunds this month.
steps.prompt_en: Say you understand now, and ask where the refunds are recorded.
answers_zh: 明白了。退款记在哪儿？
原来是这样，退款在哪一页？
answers_en: Got it. Where are refunds recorded?
I see. Which sheet are the refunds on?

steps.partner_zh: 在第二页，我给你标出来。
steps.partner_en: On the second sheet; I'll highlight it for you.
steps.prompt_en: Thank them and offer to buy them a coffee.
answers_zh: 太感谢了，我请你喝咖啡！
谢谢你，下午我请你喝咖啡吧。
answers_en: Thanks so much, coffee's on me!
Thanks, let me buy you a coffee this afternoon.
